findings.finding: Use recursion: f(0)=1; f(k)=Cat_{2^{k-1}}·(f(k‑1))². Hence N=f(20)=∏_{i=0}^{19}Cat_{2^{i}}^{2^{19‑i}}. Compute v₅(N)=Σ2^{19‑i}·v₅(Cat_{2^{i}})=121 818. k=v₅(N). Answer=121 818 mod 100 000=21 818. Ensure Catalan count = Catalan_{2^{k‑1}} (Dyck paths). Pitfall: misuse of matchings vs winner sets.

Key: Final scores are binary strings (20 bits). Each round splits a group of size 2^m into winners/losers; winners must be a Dyck set → #splits = Catalan_{2^{m‑1}}.  
N = ∏_{m=1}^{20} Catalan_{2^{m‑1}}^{2^{20‑m}}.  
v₅(N)=∑_{t=0}^{19} v₅(Catalan_{2^t})·2^{19‑t}=121 818.  
v₂(N)=2^{19}‑1=524 287.  
k=min(v₂,v₅)=121 818 → k mod 10⁵ = 21 818.  

Pitfall: ensure Catalan split count and 5‑adic valuation (use v₅(binomial)-v₅(n+1)).
